== Surname? ==

Hello People:

I chose to look at the RJWOT reference to confirm some things about Tylin and I found out that her surname is not Mitsobar, but Quintara.  In fact she is listed as Tylin Quintara of House Mitsobar.  Not sure how custom plays into listing one's name and house, I made no changes to the page, but I thought I would throw it out for some general discussion.  Should we change her page to read Tylin Quintara of House Mitsobar?
:This is kind of the same as the rest of the nobility in the series. Technically Elayne is "Elayne of House Trakand" and Galad is "Galadedrid of House Damodred" and so forth. See also, her son, who is refered to as "Beslan Mitsobar". So, her full name is Tylin Quintara Mitsobar. Her title line in the article can be changed to read "Tylin Quintara of House Mitsobar," but the page name should stay as it is. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 00:23, November 18, 2011 (UTC)
